# mxroute_forwarder (Resource)

Manage a forwarder using a destination set. Destination changes require destroy-before-create replacement and interrupt routing; create-before-destroy is not supported for a unique alias. A failed replacement create leaves the alias absent; correct the error and apply again. Forwarding to Yahoo, AOL, Gmail and similar providers automatically enables Expert Spam Filtering for the domain. This side effect is not independently managed by this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mxroute_forwarder" "sales" {
  domain       = "example.com"
  alias        = "sales"
  destinations = ["recipient@example.net", "backup@example.org"]
  # Destination changes replace the alias and interrupt routing.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alias` (String) Forwarder local part; case-insensitive lookup. Identity changes replace.
- `destinations` (Set of String) Unordered email destinations, or a single :blackhole: (discard) or :fail: (reject) target. Special targets cannot be combined with other targets. Changes replace and interrupt routing.
- `domain` (String) Owned canonical domain. Reference its resource to order cleanup.

### Read-Only

- `canonical_alias` (String) Canonical server alias.
- `email` (String) Server-reported forwarding address.
- `id` (String) Account-relative domain/lowercase-alias identity.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mxroute_forwarder.sales example.com/sales
```
